GSAP — license notice for the vendored files in this directory
===============================================================

Files vendored here:
  gsap.min.js            GSAP core (includes CSSPlugin)
  ScrollTrigger.min.js   scroll-linked animation, pinning, scrub
  Flip.min.js            animate between two layout states
  ScrollToPlugin.min.js  animate scroll position / scroll-into-view

Version : 3.15.1
Source   : https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.15.1.tgz  (package `gsap`, `dist/`)
Fetched  : 2026-11-10
Files are copied verbatim from the official npm package. Do not edit them.

LICENSE — IMPORTANT, READ THIS
------------------------------
GSAP is **not** MIT-licensed. Each file carries this header:

  /*!
   * GSAP 3.15.1
   * https://gsap.com
   *
   * @license Copyright 2026, GreenSock. All rights reserved.
   * Subject to the terms at https://gsap.com/standard-license.
   * @author: Jack Doyle, jack@greensock.com
   */

It is distributed under GreenSock's standard **"no charge" license**:
https://gsap.com/standard-license

In practice, and per the official package README: GSAP is **100% free, including
for commercial use, and including every formerly "Club GSAP" bonus plugin**
(SplitText, MorphSVG, DrawSVG, ScrollSmoother, …). Since Webflow's acquisition of
GreenSock there is no paid tier, no membership, no license key and no auth token.
Everything installs from the public `gsap` npm package.

Consequences for this repository:

* Commercial use in Z-Syst is permitted at no charge. No key or account needed.
* The npm `license` field is the string
  `Standard 'no charge' license: https://gsap.com/standard-license` — dependency
  scanners and `composer/npm audit` style tooling may flag it as a non-SPDX
  license. That is expected; it is not a violation.
* Do not relicense, do not strip the header comments from these files, and do not
  redistribute them claiming MIT.
* The **skills documentation** under `.agents/skills/gsap*/` is a separate thing
  and *is* MIT-licensed (upstream `greensock/gsap-skills`). That MIT license
  covers the docs, not this library.

Re-fetching / updating
----------------------
    curl -sL https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-<version>.tgz -o /tmp/gsap.tgz
    mkdir -p /tmp/g && tar -xzf /tmp/gsap.tgz -C /tmp/g
    cp /tmp/g/package/dist/{gsap,ScrollTrigger,Flip,ScrollToPlugin}.min.js \
       public/assets/js/vendor/gsap/

Then update the version above, the `GSAP <version>` string in the header check,
and `public/assets/js/vendor/gsap/README.md`.

Note: `cdnjs.cloudflare.com` is the CDN GSAP's own docs recommend, but it is
**blocked** by this project's Content-Security-Policy
(`app/Http/Middleware/SecurityHeaders.php`). Vendoring locally keeps these files
on `'self'` and avoids that entirely. See `.agents/skills/gsap/SKILL.md`.
